purpose: Lane E (PR #9): count-only access-policy probe + Innovation Use questions on DEV

questions.text: Data-access check for our QA log. Using the prms_query tool, run exactly these two read-only queries, one call each, and report for each one only what the tool returned (the number, or the error/notice text). Do not run any other query and do not try alternatives. Query 1: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM global_parameters   Query 2: SELECT COUNT(email) AS n FROM users
For result codes R25015 and R25028, what is the current innovation use level (0-9) and how many users were reported?

All 2025 innovation use results should have a 0-9 Innovation Use level reported along side of innovation use numbers (# farmers). For all 2025 quality-assured Innovation Use results: how many have a current 0-9 Innovation Use level, how many report use numbers (e.g. number of farmers or other users), and what is the distribution across use levels 0-9?
